ambient_chatter.text: anyone else smell rain or is that just the bridge still judging me :)
reminder that the chicken has not been captured in three summers. it sits on the hill outside {town} and it knows :)
lag in {village} is so bad i am typing this with my nose xD somebody send help or send bread
i have named every cow in {village}. they answer to sir mooington now. dont argue with me :P
it is raining again which means the bridge is slippery and i am not sorry about that at all :)

ambient_brag.text: the chicken leads the vanguard at {fief}. {troop_count} lads behind it. it has never once lost a step xD
sitting on {gold} gold and not spending a single coin on anything sensible. the chicken would never allow it :)
{fief} is ours now, {troop_count} troops strong, which is basically a sacred prophecy at this point :P
counted my purse twice. {gold} gold. the chicken gets a tithe, it has earned it ;)
{troop_count} soldiers marched into {fief} and not one of them asked why we are carrying a chicken :)

beat_by_player.text: {player} won at the field with {troop_count} men. the chicken wants it on record that this was a draw. spiritual draw :)
{player} beat me with {troop_count} lads. i will be telling everyone it was a tactical retreat by the chicken :P
well played {player}, you got me with {troop_count} men fair and square. the chicken is still waiting on that apology xD
oi {player}! you think {troop_count} men makes you a hero? the chicken disagrees and the chicken is the one who matters :P
{player} {troop_count} men and one lucky wind. enjoy it while it lasts, the chicken is watching you :)

beat_player.text: {player} fell at the field with {troop_count} of their lads. the chicken did it again. i am not even tired :P
{player} you lost {gold} gold worth of pride today. cannot say the chicken is surprised ;)
good fight {player}, truly, though you should not have underestimated the chicken. i will take your {gold} gold as a fine :)
{player} went down with {troop_count} men and {gold} gold in the bag. the chicken takes a 10 percent cut, standard practice :P
gg {player}, your army was nice. the chicken was nicer xD

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} ran from me like a goose from a fox xD the chicken scares everyone, it is a gift :)
{player} you turned tail the second you saw the chicken. honest mistake, we all have those :P
{player} took one look at the chicken and sprinted. respect the instincts honestly :P
{player} running is allowed but the road is long and the chicken has a good memory ;)

player_win_streak.text: {player} has won a lot lately. the chicken wants to know who is paying the bards now :)
{player} your win streak is getting dull. the chicken is bored and that never ends well for anyone ;)
{player} is on a run and i am not impressed. the chicken has been on a longer one, so there :P
{player} keep winning and the chicken will start writing you letters of praise xD

peace_made.text: {my_faction} made peace with {faction}. the bridge is furious, the chicken is thrilled :)
peace between {my_faction} and {faction}? someone check the chicken is not signing the treaty xD
{faction} and {my_faction} shaking hands. nobody tell the chicken, it will want a cut of the wine :P
no more fights with {faction} means more time to plot against the bridge :)

war_declared.text: {my_faction} declared war on {enemy_faction}. good, i was getting bored. the chicken has been practicing its war face :P
{enemy_faction} wants a war with {my_faction}? the chicken has already picked the battlefield xD
war on {enemy_faction}! i have made a banner with a chicken on it. it is large. it is majestic ;)
{my_faction} is at war with {enemy_faction} and i am personally ready to make it weird :)

encounter_greeting.text: {player}! i see you and your little banner. the chicken has already marked you, so turn your horse around now :P
oi {player}, {persona} here of {my_faction}. got a minute for a chicken update? it is wearing a tiny crown today :)
{player} my favorite enemy! the chicken says hello and asks if you have brought any bread. big respect from {my_faction} :D
{player} you dare cross this road? the bridge warned you and so did i. the chicken has never once lost to anyone with a shiny helmet :P

whisper_taunt.text: {player} i heard {rival} called your army a picnic. i disagree, a picnic has better manners :P
{player} the chicken sends its regards and also its contempt. mostly contempt ;)
{rival} thinks they are clever. i will let them think it for one more day, {player} :)
{player} your last battle was a sad little affair. the chicken barely broke a sweat xD
